joa_tutorial_magick_bar_kb.message:
The [c]Magick Quickslots[/c] are displayed above your elements at the bottom of the screen. These show you what Magicks you have equipped in each of the slots, how to cast them, and each Magick tier's [c]Focus[/c] level.

After casting a Magick using the [c]Magick Quickslots[/c], its [c]Focus[/c] must replenish before you can use it again. Casting a Magick using its [c]element combination[/c] does not require any [c]Focus[/c].

The [c]Magick Quickslots[/c] menu can be opened by pressing [I=shortcut_rmb,1] on a Magick slot. Bringing up this menu also displays each Magick's [c]element combination[/c].
